avoid_supplements.name: Potassium supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Losartan increases renal potassium retention; combined supplementation significantly elevates hyperkalemia risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid potassium supplements unless serum potassium is documented low and prescribed by clinician; monitor K+ levels regularly

avoid_supplements.name: NSAIDs (ibuprofen, naproxen)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: NSAIDs reduce renal perfusion and increase potassium retention; combined use increases hyperkalemia and acute kidney injury risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, use lowest NSAID dose for shortest duration and monitor renal function and K+ closely

avoid_supplements.name: ACE inhibitors
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Dual RAAS blockade significantly increases hyperkalemia, hypotension, and renal dysfunction risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid combination; if dual therapy deemed essential, require close specialist monitoring with frequent K+ and creatinine checks

caution_supplements.name: Licorice
caution_supplements.mechanism: Licorice causes sodium retention and potassium loss, potentially counteracting losartan's blood pressure lowering effects
caution_supplements.action: Limit licorice intake; counsel patient on blood pressure monitoring

caution_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
caution_supplements.mechanism: May induce CYP3A4, potentially reducing losartan levels, though clinical significance is modest
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood pressure response; inform clinician of concurrent use

avoid_foods.name: High-potassium foods (excessive intake)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Losartan reduces urinary potassium excretion; excessive dietary potassium significantly increases hyperkalemia risk
avoid_foods.action: Counsel on moderation of potassium-rich foods (bananas, oranges, spinach, tomatoes); restrict if K+ elevated or renal function impaired

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: Grapefruit inhibits CYP3A4, potentially increasing losartan levels; clinical impact is generally minimal
caution_foods.action: Counsel patient to limit grapefruit juice consumption or maintain consistent intake; monitor blood pressure

caution_foods.name: Sodium-rich foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Excess sodium may counteract antihypertensive effect of losartan
caution_foods.action: Counsel on sodium restriction consistent with hypertension management guidelines

monitoring_notes: Monitor serum potassium and renal function (creatinine, eGFR) regularly, especially at initiation or dose changes, and in patients with renal impairment or concurrent medications affecting potassium. Monitor blood pressure and counsel patients on sodium restriction and potassium moderation based on individual renal function.
